video_title: What options do the Thunder have after Jalen Williams’ injury? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder can apply for $15M disabled player exception for Jalen Williams
quotes.excerpt: Oklahoma City will be allowed to apply for the $15 million disabled player exception
quotes.quote: We are going to wait and hear for the injury news and certainly if it is deemed that Jalen Williams is out for the year, Oklahoma City will be allowed to apply for the $15 million disabled player exception. That takes into account him also being out throughout the finals here. So that is basically being determined through mid-June. They are allowed to use that. You can sign a player to a one-year contract, trade for a player in the last year of their contract, or also claim a player.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder should trade their draft assets to add talent this season
quotes.excerpt: It is time to let them go, it is too early in the season

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: Sam has a treasure chest of picks that has dust on it. He has been collecting them and it is brilliant, it is beautiful and all. Sam, it is time to let them go, man. It is time to let them go. It is too early in the season, there is still a lot of basketball to be played. I know it is easier said than done, but Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, he has big dreams for this team, so I think Sam is going to have a lot of pressure on him to figure out a way to add some talent to this team.

text_blocks.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
text_blocks.text: They are also top-heavy now in terms of salaries. This is when Chet Holmgren is making a lot of money, this is when Jalen Williams is making a lot of money, their extensions kick in, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is like, so you have this is how teams move as they go through their evolution. You had their strength was depth when they won that championship and they had to trade away some of that depth and now they have even less of it.

quotes.speaker: Monty McCutchen
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA officials will penalize forceful and full extension on off-arm push-offs
quotes.excerpt: forceful and full extension are illegal
quotes.quote: Any time that we have the concept of four F's, feeling and firming are legal separations, forceful and full extension are illegal. And we want to make sure that certainly between firming and forceful that we give consistent efforts. We are going to meet with the competition committee numerous times and I think we have some growth still there, but we have done a pretty good job and I am excited about the start that we have had to this.

quotes.speaker: Monty McCutchen
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA referees must be disciplined in mechanics to properly call push-offs
quotes.excerpt: The person who is on the defender the longest, the play slows down and therefore it makes it easier to call
quotes.quote: There are two areas. One, we want to be disciplined in our mechanics. The person who is on the defender the longest, the play slows down and therefore it makes it easier to call. So it is about discipline within our work. Secondarily, we are going to give them example upon example, hundreds of examples throughout the year. We looked at several hundred examples from last year and in last year we then applied to this year.

quotes.speaker: Monty McCutchen
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA will penalize secondary theatrical flopping with penalties
quotes.excerpt: When it becomes secondary or theatrical, that is when we want it to reach to the level of penalty
quotes.quote: We want people and players to be able to show that something illegal is taking place. But when it becomes secondary or theatrical, that is when we want it to reach to the level of penalty. If we use the competition committee as our guide and as our resource of what is and isn't, we will be able to calibrate this throughout the year with video examples, both in the offensive push-offs and in flopping, straight-line pathway plays and the other things that you saw in the POEs.
